run_findings.pr_files_cap: REST List pull request files has a 3000-file maximum; an all-pages wrapper cannot prove changed-path completeness for larger PRs. Code-owner/required-reviewer file applicability must be UNKNOWN above the cap unless another authoritative complete source is used.
run_findings.workflow_identity: Required workflow rules carry source repository_id/path plus optional ref/sha. PASS must correlate that exact source identity to complete exact-target Actions-run evidence; same-name success is insufficient.

run_findings.copilot_raw_key: A public github/docs active ruleset exposes require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_changes=true. This is the exact raw source for the verifier's Copilot extra-approval normalization.
run_findings.stack_public_capability: Public GitHub now exposes REST stack list/get/create/add/remove plus mandatory async stack merge. Stack merge is atomic for the contiguous bottom-through-requested group and rules are evaluated later. Create has no documented idempotency key/expected-version; add/remove use 409 for concurrent modification but no old-version CAS.
run_findings.stack_exact_intent: Async merge sha binds only the requested PR head. Pending result exposes one expected_head_sha plus method/action, not a vector for lower stack members. Exact-intent recovery therefore persists stack id/number, base, ordered per-member heads/bases and requested top H; 202/409 result identity is necessary but insufficient to prove every layer boundary remained identical.
run_findings.stack_connector_gap: No connected stack-specific or async-merge action was discovered. Generic fetch rejected public /repos/.../stacks as outside allowlist and exposes no caller-controlled API-version header; synchronous expected-head merge and auto-merge are not substitutes because GitHub forbids legacy sync merge for stacks and does not support auto-merge for stacked PRs.
run_findings.stack_queue_groups: A queued stack may exceed merge-group max size by up to 50 percent, and larger stacks can split across consecutive merge groups. Queue proof must support an ordered sequence of merge-group SHAs, not assume one stack equals one merge-group SHA.
